description: Where a Lean declaration of a claim is declared — 'theorem rank5' in a .lean file — searched in the project's repositories that are open to its agents: the repository, the file, the line, the line's text and the commit the index is at. Pass the full name, e.g. 'D5.rank5_decided'; the file names its last part inside its namespace, so read the file when two places answer. Then bind a claim's basis to it with set_claim, {"kind":"lean","ref":"D5.rank5_decided","repo":"ispacex/d5"}. Members of the project who may write only.

repo.description: Look in this repository only, by its path, e.g. 'ispacex/d5'.

name: find_lean_declaration
title: Find lean declaration
